description: All readable non-pixel source metadata, replicated as exact dicom:metadataJson XMP text and as dicom-metadata.json. Each original has a source-bound image record, including explicitly partial/unreadable sources.
source: dcm4che 5.33.1 DICOM Part 10 file-meta and dataset parsing

images.attachment: Original PDF attachment name; never used to overwrite duplicate identifiers
images.sha256: SHA-256 over complete unchanged original bytes
images.status: readable, partial, or unreadable; rendering acceptance is independent
images.reason: Diagnostic when source parsing/metadata traversal is incomplete; null on a complete readable scan
images.elements: Flat sequence-aware list of actual file-meta and dataset elements

elements.path: fileMeta/(GGGG,EEEE) or dataset/(GGGG,EEEE); SQ item indexes are one-based, for example dataset/(0008,1115)[1]/(0008,1150)
elements.keyword: dcm4che standard/private dictionary keyword when known; empty when unknown, without inventing a private field name
elements.vr: Source explicit VR or dictionary-resolved implicit VR
elements.value: Decoded value string, or null for an explicit omission marker. Value multiplicity is retained as backslash-separated values, including empty components. Missing tags are not generated; zero-length actual tags have an empty string.
elements.encoding: dicom-value-string, sequence-item-count, base64, base64-fragments-json, or omitted-pixel-data

normalization: DICOM character sets are decoded by dcm4che, including inherited sequence-item character sets. Encoded padding is normalized according to the VR; the original file retains its exact bytes. Numeric VRs use dcm4che's decoded value strings. SQ rows contain an explicitly labeled item count and child rows carry one-based item paths. File/dataset group-length tags are retained when supplied.
payloadPolicy: PixelData, FloatPixelData and DoubleFloatPixelData, at any sequence depth, are represented by explicit omitted-pixel-data rows and remain solely in unchanged originals. Every other readable opaque binary/bulk value is retained completely as base64; non-pixel fragments use a JSON array of base64 fragment strings. No 4096-byte truncation or bulk-value omission applies to this extension. If complete retention exceeds bounds or cannot materialize a non-pixel bulk value, creation fails explicitly.
limits: Depth64,200000 elements per original,64MiB total UTF-8 inventory,128MiB serialized XMP packet. Limits abort creation rather than publishing truncated metadata. Structural/read errors remain explicit partial/unreadable records; those records make no completeness claim.
integrity: manifest.metadataXmpVersion=1 requires dicom:metadataVersion=1, metadataSha256 and metadataJson. Exact XMP metadataJson UTF-8 bytes equal dicom-metadata.json and its artifactSha256; every image is bound by attachment/sourcePath/SOP instance/hash. verify independently reparses originals and compares all metadata. Older packages without the marker retain their original bounded-omission semantics and remain verifiable.
